name: Mensculine
tagline: SuamiSihat's men's care brand for export markets

definition.summary: Mensculine is the international identity for SuamiSihat men's care products sold outside Malaysia, starting with Mensculine Care Cream.

facts.label: Logo set
facts.value: Primary, secondary and text lockups, each in light and dark

range.name: Mensculine Care Cream
range.desc: Topical care cream; successor formulation to the archived Xprimal line.

definition.claimsReview: Ingredient and effect statements must follow each export market's cosmetic rules.

images.alt: Mensculine logo on a white card over the blue chevron pattern
images.caption: Brand card (product photography pending)

positioning.statement: For men abroad who want straightforward care from a specialist, Mensculine carries SuamiSihat's know-how in a clean, international look.

pillars.title: Bold simplicity
pillars.text: Black, white and one vivid blue.

avoid: Market-specific claims that are not cleared

colors.name: Vivid Blue
colors.use: Icon in logo, one highlight on black

pairings.use: Black text on a blue badge

colorScheme.note: White on Vivid Blue is 3.5:1; use Obsidian text on blue.

pattern.name: Chevron Drive
pattern.description: Stacked Vivid Blue chevrons on Obsidian, pointing forward.
usage: Use on dark bands and packaging sides

guideline.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark on every side. Nothing (text, edges, other logos) enters this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Digital 120 px wide; print 30 mm wide
do: Use the light or dark lockup to match the background
Keep Vivid Blue to the icon and one highlight
Use English as the primary language
dont: Do not mix light and dark lockups
Do not use the archived Xprimal identity

typography.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold (SuamiSihat master display face)
typography.body: Inter Regular / Medium for UI and long copy
typography.note: Never retype a wordmark; always place the supplied logo file.
